mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deadline_reminder (account_id, source_code, source_program_id, kind, due_date, days_before, email_status, push_status, created_at) SELECT setting.account_id, program.source_code, program.source_program_id, 'DEADLINE', program.application_end_date, DATEDIFF(program.application_end_date, #{today}), CASE WHEN setting.deadline_reminder_email = TRUE THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_REQUESTED' END, CASE WHEN setting.deadline_reminder_push = TRUE THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_REQUESTED' END, #{now} FROM account_notification_setting setting JOIN account ON account.id = setting.account_id JOIN saved_support_program saved ON saved.account_id = setting.account_id JOIN support_program program ON program.id = saved.support_program_id WHERE setting.deadline_reminder_enabled = TRUE AND account.deleted_at IS NULL AND account.suspended_at IS NULL AND program.is_source_present = TRUE AND program.application_end_date IN DATE_ADD(#{today}, INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE due_date = deadline_reminder.due_date
mapper.update: UPDATE deadline_reminder SET email_status = 'SENDING', email_started_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND email_status = 'PENDING' AND created_at >= #{since}
UPDATE deadline_reminder SET push_status = 'SENDING', push_started_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND push_status = 'PENDING' AND created_at >= #{since}
UPDATE deadline_reminder SET email_status = #{status}, email_error = #{error}, email_finished_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND email_status = 'SENDING'
UPDATE deadline_reminder SET push_status = #{status}, push_error = #{error}, push_finished_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND push_status = 'SENDING'

UPDATE deadline_reminder SET email_status = CASE WHEN email_status = 'PENDING' THEN 'SKIPPED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END, email_error = 'Expired', email_finished_at = #{now} WHERE (email_status = 'PENDING' AND created_at < #{since}) OR (email_status = 'SENDING' AND email_started_at < #{sendingBefore})

UPDATE deadline_reminder SET push_status = CASE WHEN push_status = 'PENDING' THEN 'SKIPPED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END, push_error = 'Expired', push_finished_at = #{now} WHERE (push_status = 'PENDING' AND created_at < #{since}) OR (push_status = 'SENDING' AND push_started_at < #{sendingBefore})
